plugins.name: ahoo-wow-skills
plugins.description: Intent-focused Agent Skills for developing, reviewing, debugging, and migrating Wow reactive DDD, Event Sourcing, and CQRS services, plus building TypeScript clients and generating them from OpenAPI, and answering business data questions from a running Wow service's read-only queries.

interface.defaultPrompt: Help me develop, review, debug, or migrate this downstream application that uses Wow, or build and generate its TypeScript clients, using verifiable evidence.
